{{Top|leg}}
The '''Inner Moddell systems''' were a group a [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] in the [[spinward]] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

The Inner Moddell systems included [[Annaj/Legends|Annaj]] (the sector capital), [[Hanchin]] and its moon [[Qina/Legends|Qina]], [[Kuna's Tooth/Legends|Kuna's Tooth]], [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]], [[Ovise system/Legends|Ovise system]], [[Thonner/Legends|Thonner]], [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]], and [[Vex system/Legends|Vex]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Most of the Moddell sector's traffic was found on the [[Houche Run/Legends|Annaj-Houche Run]], mading up the Inner Moddell systems. Traffic dropped off considerably in the [[Outer Moddell systems|Outer Moddell]] beyond those systems.<ref name="Atlas" />
